info.name: FixTradeZone Local API MASTER v13 - PKG-01 Package Plan Foundation
info.description:
Single self-contained local Postman collection for FixTradeZone. v10 preserves the v9 backend, RBAC, user/admin provisioning, impersonation, security settings, configurable authentication/registration and CAPTCHA coverage; fixes the current BFF login contract to identifier/password; adds folder 14 for role-aware login + native standard USER dashboard/session verification; and moves runtime state from Postman Environment scope to namespaced ftz_* COLLECTION variables. This collection never writes to or unsets Postman Environment variables. For current folder 14, set only ftz_superAdminPassword in Collection Variables and keep backend/frontend running on the default local ports, or override ftz_baseUrl / ftz_adminBaseUrl in Collection Variables. v11 adds folder 15 for MLM-01 referral/sponsor foundation verification: SUPER_ADMIN referral configuration/root, default-sponsor enrollment, explicit referral-code enrollment, self profile/direct referrals, invalid-code transactional rollback, self/cycle rejection, SUPER_ADMIN sponsor-change authority, delegated ADMIN permission/config gating, and cleanup of temporary ADMIN permission/config state. Run folder 15 against the local backend after the repository verify:milestone gate is green. Set ftz_superAdminPassword in Collection Variables.

v12: Adds an automatic SUPER_ADMIN refresh before MLM-01 cleanup/final verification to make the folder resilient to the 15-minute access-token TTL during manual runs.

v13: Preserves all v12 requests unchanged and adds folder 16 for PKG-01 Package Plan Foundation verification. Folder 16 intentionally bridges to the existing FixTradeZone Local - FINAL v2 Postman environment: it logs in with baseUrl/superAdminEmail/superAdminPassword, stores fresh SUPER_ADMIN tokens in that environment, then runs the 13 ordered package-plan acceptance requests. Run folder 16 once after migration 0007 and milestone verification are green.
